assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, HiSeq 4000, Cufflinks/Cuffdiff 2.1.0 on mm9 (S4.9.p1; GEO data_processing)
samples: 6 samples of the immortalized C2C12 mouse myoblast cell line differentiated to myotubes in culture: 3 WT (C2C12WT1-3) and 3 CRISPR Lrrc8a KO (C2C12KO1-3), basal culture conditions (GEO overall_design; FIG1 legend n = 3 each)
primary_estimand: Effect of Lrrc8a (SWELL1) gene deletion on gene expression in differentiated C2C12 myotubes in vitro (S2.2.p1). No exercise estimand: the sequenced samples are a cell line with no exercise, training, contraction or stretch arm.
planned_contrasts: Lrrc8a KO vs WT C2C12 myotubes (S2.2.p1, FIG1 D-F; Supplementary file 1) — genotype contrast, not exercise
exercise_in_paper: Only a treadmill exercise-tolerance test of skeletal-muscle Lrrc8a KO vs WT mice as a phenotype readout (S4.19.p1; ABS.p1 'reduced exercise endurance'); no tissue from it was sequenced. Stretch stimulation (S4.12.p1) was read out by western blot only.
repeated_measure_unit: none (independent culture replicates of two isogenic cell lines)
paper_method: Cufflinks Assembly and DE (Cuffdiff) v2.1.0 on FPKM (S4.9.p1)
paper_results: No total DEG count stated; heatmap of top 17 DEGs (FIG1 D); named genes Mef2a, Myl2, Myl3, Myl4, Actc1, Tnnc2, Igf2 down; Ppargc1a, Pparg up; Akt2, Slc2a4, Foxo3/4/6 down (S2.2.p1, S2.3.p1)
